title: 6 第六章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那是一切尘埃落定后，都竞华立于废弃小区中，安静擦拭箭矢时的场景。

背景阴暗，锋锐的箭矢上还沾着血迹，都竞华的脸颊被鬓边的碎发遮住了一部分，肤色被黑暗衬托得异常苍白。她的目光幽冷，神色间还带着未曾消退的绝意。可即使如此冷酷，她的动作中依旧带着一丝克制的从容。

“……”

可能是角度问题，都竞华盯着脑海中的自己，总觉得对方格外不像好人，很怀疑游戏给原本正常的画面添加了暗黑特效……

只能说系统是会挑选留影角度的。

【系统：玩家获得技能[仪式感]。】

[仪式感（RI，可成长）：经常▇人的朋友们都知道，适当的仪式感总能给人带来满足感与幸福感。该技能为被动能力，每次击杀敌对目标时，有1%的概率获得场景相关的额外惊喜。该技能受到所有使用者的好评，除非口是心非。]

从介绍上分析，都竞华暂且认为[仪式感]是一个提升掉落率的技能。

乍看还算不错，可目前获得惊喜的概率实在很低，只有1%，再考虑都竞华日常的幸运程度，她觉得自己不用指望太多。

要让都竞华自行分类，她更倾向于[仪式感]放在N级里面，但游戏对[仪式感]的评价却与她有所不同，再加上那个“可成长”的标签……

说是可成长，系统却没有标明成长方式。

论坛上介绍过，很多技能，包括刚刚的[火球术]，其实都能通过道具或者技能卡来提升自身威力。

既然如此，系统为什么要额外加上一句提醒？

[仪式感]会在击杀目标时生效，都竞华怀疑括号中信息的意思是就算不用道具，自己只要砍得敌方目标够多，技能就可以自然升级。

都竞华想，要是自己最后真的走上了pvp的道路，根源一定不是自己好斗，而是游戏总是暗搓搓地威逼利诱。

从论坛上的情况看，现阶段N级技能卡都很少见，R卡更是堪称稀有，更高等级的技能几乎完全被最早觉醒的那一批玩家所垄断。也难怪之前过来狩猎的三名袭击者打得如此被动，要是他们也有类似的移动技能，临时事件的结果一定会大不相同。

随后都竞华又用的信息。

跟预料的一样，对于连N级技能都十分珍贵的玩家群体而言，目前的主流装备还是白色等级，别说目前只在梦里的紫装，连稍高一级的绿色物品都非常罕见。

商业区中有交易行，都竞华想”。

游戏充满危险，却又会抓住所有机会向玩家展示自己的力量，无声催促都竞华尽快开始探索。

都竞华没有遵循游戏的意愿即刻前往主城区，而是先耐着性子将所有能查看的界面又仔细看了一遍，接着发现了上面居然有着等级榜的存在。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

That was the scene when Du Jinghua stood in the abandoned community and quietly wiped the arrows after all the dust had settled.

The background was dark, and the sharp arrows were still stained with blood. Du Jinghua's cheeks were partially covered by the broken hair at his temples, and his skin color was extremely pale against the darkness.Her eyes were cold, with a look of determination that had not faded.But even though she was so cold, there was still a hint of restraint and calmness in her movements.

"..."

It might be a matter of angle. Du Jinghua stared at himself in his mind. He always felt that the other person did not look like a good person. He suspected that the game added dark special effects to the originally normal picture...

It can only be said that the system will choose the angle for taking pictures.

[System: Players acquire skills [sense of ritual].】

[Ritual sense (RI, can grow): Friends of ordinary people know that an appropriate sense of ritual can always bring people a sense of satisfaction and happiness.This skill is a passive ability. Every time you kill a hostile target, there is a 1% chance of obtaining additional surprises related to the scene.This skill is well-received by all users unless they are duplicitous.]

Based on the introduction, Du Jinghua temporarily believes that [Ritual Sense] is a skill that increases the drop rate.

At first glance, it looked pretty good, but the current probability of getting a surprise was really low, only 1%. Considering Du Jinghua's daily luck, she felt that she didn't need to expect too much.

If Du Jinghua is asked to classify it by herself, she prefers to put [Ritual Sense] in the N level, but the game's evaluation of [Ritual Sense] is different from hers, plus the "growable" label...

It is said that it can grow, but the system does not indicate the growth method.

It has been introduced on the forum that many skills, including the [Fireball Technique] just now, can actually increase their power through props or skill cards.

In this case, why does the system add an additional reminder?

[Ritual Sense] will take effect when the target is killed. Du Jinghua suspected that the information in the brackets meant that even if he did not use props, as long as he killed enough enemy targets, his skills would be naturally upgraded.

Du Jinghua thought that if he finally embarked on the path of pvp, the root cause must not be that he was aggressive, but that the game always used secret threats and inducements.

Judging from the situation on the forum, N-level skill cards are very rare at this stage, and R-level cards are even rarer. Higher-level skills are almost completely monopolized by the first group of players to awaken.It's no wonder that the three attackers who came to hunt before were so passive. If they had similar movement skills, the outcome of the temporary incident would have been very different.

Later, Du Jinghua used the information again.

As expected, for a player group where even N-level skills are very precious, the current mainstream equipment is still white level. Not to mention the purple equipment that is only in dreams at the moment, even slightly higher level green items are very rare.

There are trading houses in the business district, and they all want to compete with each other."

The game is full of danger, but it will seize every opportunity to show its power to the players, silently urging Du Jinghua to start exploring as soon as possible.

Du Jinghua did not follow the wishes of the game and immediately go to the main city. Instead, he patiently looked at all the interfaces that could be viewed carefully, and then discovered that there was actually a level list on it.
